(Achievement of the Year) ] || ---------------- || (This is a review of installing a dishwasher and remodeling the sink.) When I moved into a new apartment, I did some interior design and bought appliances and furniture, and the first thing I considered was a dishwasher! I saw a commercial dishwasher while working part-time at a cafe and was blown away by its new design. However, I couldn't afford a commercial dishwasher at home, and due to budget constraints during the move, I looked for branded, reasonably priced products. Korea's leading home appliance brands are Samsung and L*ny, and Samsung products are more affordable, so I ended up choosing almost all Samsung products. There's a saying that "L*" is a household name for appliances, so when I moved to my parents' house, I had all the Samsung products, but this time, my budget didn't allow it. I had been very satisfied with the built-in Samsung appliances in my previous studio apartment, so I trusted them and bought a Samsung product. The installation process: I'd been eyeing the dishwasher on Coupang for a few days, and when the price improved, I bought it. I scheduled the installation for the day I moved in. The day before the installation, I got a call to schedule a visit. The dishwasher was unusual in that the sink remodeler came first, and then the dishwasher installer came separately. The remodeling felt like a bigger and more important task than the dishwasher installation, and it actually took longer. I wasn't very busy moving, but the installer came and went, and I think it took about an hour. They had to make room for the dishwasher, so in our case, we removed the oven under the induction range and installed the dishwasher there. However, the countertop didn't match, so we had to pay for the remodeling. ((It came out to be in the mid-100,000 won range, so I paid for it separately from the dishwasher.)) I didn't realize there was an additional remodeling fee, and it was even in the 100,000 won range. But I paid for the dishwasher anyway. The remodeling was incredibly thorough. They even applied film to the kitchen sink a week before the move, and they said it was a good idea to apply the film after the dishwasher was installed. Our house was installed in the following order: sink film removal, move-in cleaning, and dishwasher installation. The installer said it's better to install the dishwasher first because the film could peel off or cause problems during installation. 1. The best appliance in my life: a dishwasher. I used to get so angry when I came home that the sink was full of dishes to wash, and I'd get so angry when I had to wash them and cook. But now, even when the sink is full of dishes, I don't complain at all. It still feels like play. I don't feel the burden of washing dishes anymore. As I got older, my shoulders would hurt from washing dishes, and my back would get sore from standing for long periods. I'd often take breaks and then start again. But since the dishwasher arrived, dishwashing stress has disappeared. 2. A dishwasher with a maximum capacity of 14 people. People always say you should buy a 14-person dishwasher, but I think bigger is always better. I'm thinking about getting another 14-person dishwasher. It seats 14 people, but if you add a rice cooker inner pot, wok, or frying pan, the lower compartment is almost full. I think it was a good decision to get a large capacity. I'm still new to using it, so it was a bit difficult to stack dishes neatly. 3. Easy operation. I've never seen a home dishwasher before, and I saw it for the first time during installation. The technician showed me how to do it, but I forgot about it the next time I left, so I tried again and it was easy. 4. Cleanliness. I use Pro* dishwasher detergent, which is the most commonly used, and at first, there was some detergent residue, but with use, that residue disappeared and now it's clean. I used to use one bottle of Pro* dishwasher detergent, but I cut it in half. This half-bottle size is just the right amount, and the dishes feel cleaner. Sometimes, water collects where I place dishes upside down, and that water seems to contain detergent residue. Sometimes, I rinse the dishes with water to check if I washed them properly. I also pre-wash the dishes. There are still a few things to do with the dishwasher, rather than just throwing them in, but I'm so glad I bought it. Washing dishes takes a lot of effort and time, like scrubbing them with a sponge and then rinsing them thoroughly with water. But with the dishwasher, I've saved time, labor, and the mental stress associated with washing dishes. Stress is the root of all evil. Mental health is paramount, and this dishwasher makes me feel like I'm taking care of my mental health. I didn't research dishwashers well and bought them because of the brand and price, but foreign brands cost millions of won. This is the best domestic brand, and with this performance at this price, I think I made a good purchase! (Achievement of the Year) ] || ---------------- || (This is a review of installing a dishwasher and remodeling the sink.) When I moved into a new apartment, I did some interior design and bought appliances and furniture, and the first thing I considered was a dishwasher! I saw a commercial dishwasher while working part-time at a cafe and was blown away by its new design. However, I couldn't afford a commercial dishwasher at home, and due to budget constraints during the move, I looked for branded, reasonably priced products. Korea's leading home appliance brands are Samsung and L*ny, and Samsung products are more affordable, so I ended up choosing almost all Samsung products. There's a saying that "L*" is a household name for appliances, so when I moved to my parents' house, I had all the Samsung products, but this time, my budget didn't allow it. I had been very satisfied with the built-in Samsung appliances in my previous studio apartment, so I trusted them and bought a Samsung product. The installation process: I'd been eyeing the dishwasher on Coupang for a few days, and when the price improved, I bought it. I scheduled the installation for the day I moved in. The day before the installation, I got a call to schedule a visit. The dishwasher was unusual in that the sink remodeler came first, and then the dishwasher installer came separately. The remodeling felt like a bigger and more important task than the dishwasher installation, and it actually took longer. I wasn't very busy moving, but the installer came and went, and I think it took about an hour. They had to make room for the dishwasher, so in our case, we removed the oven under the induction range and installed the dishwasher there. However, the countertop didn't match, so we had to pay for the remodeling. ((It came out to be in the mid-100,000 won range, so I paid for it separately from the dishwasher.)) I didn't realize there was an additional remodeling fee, and it was even in the 100,000 won range. But I paid for the dishwasher anyway. The remodeling was incredibly thorough. They even applied film to the kitchen sink a week before the move, and they said it was a good idea to apply the film after the dishwasher was installed. Our house was installed in the following order: sink film removal, move-in cleaning, and dishwasher installation. The installer said it's better to install the dishwasher first because the film could peel off or cause problems during installation. 1. The best appliance in my life: a dishwasher. I used to get so angry when I came home that the sink was full of dishes to wash, and I'd get so angry when I had to wash them and cook. But now, even when the sink is full of dishes, I don't complain at all. It still feels like play. I don't feel the burden of washing dishes anymore. As I got older, my shoulders would hurt from washing dishes, and my back would get sore from standing for long periods. I'd often take breaks and then start again. But since the dishwasher arrived, dishwashing stress has disappeared. 2. A dishwasher with a maximum capacity of 14 people. People always say you should buy a 14-person dishwasher, but I think bigger is always better. I'm thinking about getting another 14-person dishwasher. It seats 14 people, but if you add a rice cooker inner pot, wok, or frying pan, the lower compartment is almost full. I think it was a good decision to get a large capacity. I'm still new to using it, so it was a bit difficult to stack dishes neatly. 3. Easy operation. I've never seen a home dishwasher before, and I saw it for the first time during installation. The technician showed me how to do it, but I forgot about it the next time I left, so I tried again and it was easy. 4. Cleanliness. I use Pro* dishwasher detergent, which is the most commonly used, and at first, there was some detergent residue, but with use, that residue disappeared and now it's clean. I used to use one bottle of Pro* dishwasher detergent, but I cut it in half. This half-bottle size is just the right amount, and the dishes feel cleaner. Sometimes, water collects where I place dishes upside down, and that water seems to contain detergent residue. Sometimes, I rinse the dishes with water to check if I washed them properly. I also pre-wash the dishes. There are still a few things to do with the dishwasher, rather than just throwing them in, but I'm so glad I bought it. Washing dishes takes a lot of effort and time, like scrubbing them with a sponge and then rinsing them thoroughly with water. But with the dishwasher, I've saved time, labor, and the mental stress associated with washing dishes. Stress is the root of all evil. Mental health is paramount, and this dishwasher makes me feel like I'm taking care of my mental health. I didn't research dishwashers well and bought them because of the brand and price, but foreign brands cost millions of won. This is the best domestic brand, and with this performance at this price, I think I made a good purchase! (Achievement of the Year) ] || ---------------- || (This is a review of installing a dishwasher and remodeling the sink.) When I moved into a new apartment, I did some interior design and bought appliances and furniture, and the first thing I considered was a dishwasher! I saw a commercial dishwasher while working part-time at a cafe and was blown away by its new design. However, I couldn't afford a commercial dishwasher at home, and due to budget constraints during the move, I looked for branded, reasonably priced products. Korea's leading home appliance brands are Samsung and L*ny, and Samsung products are more affordable, so I ended up choosing almost all Samsung products. There's a saying that "L*" is a household name for appliances, so when I moved to my parents' house, I had all the Samsung products, but this time, my budget didn't allow it. I had been very satisfied with the built-in Samsung appliances in my previous studio apartment, so I trusted them and bought a Samsung product. The installation process: I'd been eyeing the dishwasher on Coupang for a few days, and when the price improved, I bought it. I scheduled the installation for the day I moved in. The day before the installation, I got a call to schedule a visit. The dishwasher was unusual in that the sink remodeler came first, and then the dishwasher installer came separately. The remodeling felt like a bigger and more important task than the dishwasher installation, and it actually took longer. I wasn't very busy moving, but the installer came and went, and I think it took about an hour. They had to make room for the dishwasher, so in our case, we removed the oven under the induction range and installed the dishwasher there. However, the countertop didn't match, so we had to pay for the remodeling. ((It came out to be in the mid-100,000 won range, so I paid for it separately from the dishwasher.)) I didn't realize there was an additional remodeling fee, and it was even in the 100,000 won range. But I paid for the dishwasher anyway. The remodeling was incredibly thorough. They even applied film to the kitchen sink a week before the move, and they said it was a good idea to apply the film after the dishwasher was installed. Our house was installed in the following order: sink film removal, move-in cleaning, and dishwasher installation. The installer said it's better to install the dishwasher first because the film could peel off or cause problems during installation. 1. The best appliance in my life: a dishwasher. I used to get so angry when I came home that the sink was full of dishes to wash, and I'd get so angry when I had to wash them and cook. But now, even when the sink is full of dishes, I don't complain at all. It still feels like play. I don't feel the burden of washing dishes anymore. As I got older, my shoulders would hurt from washing dishes, and my back would get sore from standing for long periods. I'd often take breaks and then start again. But since the dishwasher arrived, dishwashing stress has disappeared. 2. A dishwasher with a maximum capacity of 14 people. People always say you should buy a 14-person dishwasher, but I think bigger is always better. I'm thinking about getting another 14-person dishwasher. It seats 14 people, but if you add a rice cooker inner pot, wok, or frying pan, the lower compartment is almost full. I think it was a good decision to get a large capacity. I'm still new to using it, so it was a bit difficult to stack dishes neatly. 3. Easy operation. I've never seen a home dishwasher before, and I saw it for the first time during installation. The technician showed me how to do it, but I forgot about it the next time I left, so I tried again and it was easy. 4. Cleanliness. I use Pro* dishwasher detergent, which is the most commonly used, and at first, there was some detergent residue, but with use, that residue disappeared and now it's clean. I used to use one bottle of Pro* dishwasher detergent, but I cut it in half. This half-bottle size is just the right amount, and the dishes feel cleaner. Sometimes, water collects where I place dishes upside down, and that water seems to contain detergent residue. Sometimes, I rinse the dishes with water to check if I washed them properly. I also pre-wash the dishes. There are still a few things to do with the dishwasher, rather than just throwing them in, but I'm so glad I bought it. Washing dishes takes a lot of effort and time, like scrubbing them with a sponge and then rinsing them thoroughly with water. But with the dishwasher, I've saved time, labor, and the mental stress associated with washing dishes. Stress is the root of all evil. Mental health is paramount, and this dishwasher makes me feel like I'm taking care of my mental health. I didn't research dishwashers well and bought them because of the brand and price, but foreign brands cost millions of won. This is the best domestic brand, and with this performance at this price, I think I made a good purchase! ((십 만원대 중반 가격이 나와서 식기세척기 값이랑 별도로 결재 했어요.))리폼 비용이 추가로 드는건 몰랐는데, 심지어 십만원대... 그래도 식기세척기를 위해 결제했습니다. 리폼은 엄청 깔끔하게 해주셨어요. 이사 1주일 전에 주방 싱크대 필름지 작업을 미리 했는데, 식기 세척기를 설치하고 필름지 작업이 좋다고 하십니다...저희 집은 싱크대 필름지 작업 -> 입주청소 -> 식기세척기 설치 순으로 진행했는데, 기사님 말씀으로는 식기세척기 설치하면서 필름지가 벗거지거나 문제가 생길 수 있어서 식기세척기부터 설치하는게 좋다고 하시네요. 1.인생 최고의 가전제품 식기세척기집에 오면 설거지할 그릇이 싱크대에 쌓여있고, 이걸 씻어서 음식을 조리할 때 분노가 치밀어 올랐는데 이제는 싱크대에 설거지거리가 잔뜩 쌓여있어도 전혀 불만이 없고, 아직까지는 놀이를 하는 기분입니다.이제 설거지 부담이 없어요. 나이가 들면서 설거지하면 어깨도 아프고 오래 서있으면 허리가 욱신거려서 설거지 하다가 중간에 쉬었다가 다시 하고 그랬는데 식기세척기가 생긴 이후로는 설거지 스트레스가 제로가 되었습니다.2.14인용 최대 용량 식기세척기식기세척기 무조건 14인용으로 사라고 하던데, 식기세척기는 크면 클수록 좋은 것 같아요.14인용 식기세척기 한 대 더 들여놓고 싶기도 합니다.14인용이지만 밥솥 내솥이랑 웍이나 후라이팬 넣으면 아래칸은 거의 꽉 찹니다.대용량을 하길 잘한 것 같습니다.저는 아직 요령이 부족한 건지 그릇을 차곡차곡 많이 넣기는 좀 어렵더라고요.3.쉬운 작동방법가정용 식기세척기는 본 적이 없고, 저도 설치하면서 처음 봤어요.기사님께서 알려주셨지만 돌아서면 까먹어서 다시 해봤는데 쉽더라고요.4.깔끔한 처리식기세척기 세제를 프로*으로 제일 많이 사용하는 걸로 쓰는데 처음에는 잔여세제 같은 것이 묻어놨는데 사용하면 사용할수록 그런게 없어져서 이제 깨끗하게 됩니다.프로* 식기세척기 전용세제 1개 쓰다가 반으로 잘라서 쓰고 있는데 반으로 잘라서 사용하니 적정 용량이라 그릇이 더 잘닦이는 느낌입니다.그릇 뒤집어 놓은 곳에 물이 고이기도 하고, 그 물이 세제가 남은 느낌이기도 하고, 가끔 잘 씻겼나 싶은 마음에 물로 한번씩 더 헹구기도 합니다. 또 애벌 설거지도 합니다. 식기세척기에 그냥 넣어버리는게 아니라 할 일들이 좀 있긴 하지만, 그래도 사길 훨씬 잘했습니다. 설거지를 하면 박박 문질러서 수세미로 닦고, 물로 열심히 헹구고 이러다보면 힘이 많이 들어가고 시간도 많이 드는데 식기 세척기로 시간도 줄고, 노동도 줄고, 설거지로 인한 정신적 스트레스도 없어졌어요. 만병의 근원인 스트레스...정신건강이 가장 중요한데 이 식기세척기로 인해 정신적 건강을 챙기는 느낌이 들어요.식기세척기 잘 안알아보고 브랜드랑 가격 좋아서 구입했는데 해외 브랜드는 수백만원씩하더라고요. 국내 최고의 브랜드인데 이 가격에 이 성능이면 잘 샀다고 생각해요!!식기세척기로 시간 절약하시고, 정신건강도 챙기셔요~^^ 식기세척기 구입은 강력 추천합니다.●열심히 쓴 저의 후기 아래 ▶도움이돼요◀ 꼭! 눌러주시면 감사하겠습니다.●

(Achievement of the Year) ] || ---------------- || (This is a review of installing a dishwasher and remodeling the sink.) When I moved into a new apartment, I did some interior design and bought appliances and furniture, and the first thing I considered was a dishwasher! I saw a commercial dishwasher while working part-time at a cafe and was blown away by its new design. However, I couldn't afford a commercial dishwasher at home, and due to budget constraints during the move, I looked for branded, reasonably priced products. Korea's leading home appliance brands are Samsung and L*ny, and Samsung products are more affordable, so I ended up choosing almost all Samsung products. There's a saying that "L*" is a household name for appliances, so when I moved to my parents' house, I had all the Samsung products, but this time, my budget didn't allow it. I had been very satisfied with the built-in Samsung appliances in my previous studio apartment, so I trusted them and bought a Samsung product. The installation process: I'd been eyeing the dishwasher on Coupang for a few days, and when the price improved, I bought it. I scheduled the installation for the day I moved in. The day before the installation, I got a call to schedule a visit. The dishwasher was unusual in that the sink remodeler came first, and then the dishwasher installer came separately. The remodeling felt like a bigger and more important task than the dishwasher installation, and it actually took longer. I wasn't very busy moving, but the installer came and went, and I think it took about an hour. They had to make room for the dishwasher, so in our case, we removed the oven under the induction range and installed the dishwasher there. However, the countertop didn't match, so we had to pay for the remodeling. ((It came out to be in the mid-100,000 won range, so I paid for it separately from the dishwasher.)) I didn't realize there was an additional remodeling fee, and it was even in the 100,000 won range. But I paid for the dishwasher anyway. The remodeling was incredibly thorough. They even applied film to the kitchen sink a week before the move, and they said it was a good idea to apply the film after the dishwasher was installed. Our house was installed in the following order: sink film removal, move-in cleaning, and dishwasher installation. The installer said it's better to install the dishwasher first because the film could peel off or cause problems during installation. 1. The best appliance in my life: a dishwasher. I used to get so angry when I came home that the sink was full of dishes to wash, and I'd get so angry when I had to wash them and cook. But now, even when the sink is full of dishes, I don't complain at all. It still feels like play. I don't feel the burden of washing dishes anymore. As I got older, my shoulders would hurt from washing dishes, and my back would get sore from standing for long periods. I'd often take breaks and then start again. But since the dishwasher arrived, dishwashing stress has disappeared. 2. A dishwasher with a maximum capacity of 14 people. People always say you should buy a 14-person dishwasher, but I think bigger is always better. I'm thinking about getting another 14-person dishwasher. It seats 14 people, but if you add a rice cooker inner pot, wok, or frying pan, the lower compartment is almost full. I think it was a good decision to get a large capacity. I'm still new to using it, so it was a bit difficult to stack dishes neatly. 3. Easy operation. I've never seen a home dishwasher before, and I saw it for the first time during installation. The technician showed me how to do it, but I forgot about it the next time I left, so I tried again and it was easy. 4. Cleanliness. I use Pro* dishwasher detergent, which is the most commonly used, and at first, there was some detergent residue, but with use, that residue disappeared and now it's clean. I used to use one bottle of Pro* dishwasher detergent, but I cut it in half. This half-bottle size is just the right amount, and the dishes feel cleaner. Sometimes, water collects where I place dishes upside down, and that water seems to contain detergent residue. Sometimes, I rinse the dishes with water to check if I washed them properly. I also pre-wash the dishes. There are still a few things to do with the dishwasher, rather than just throwing them in, but I'm so glad I bought it. Washing dishes takes a lot of effort and time, like scrubbing them with a sponge and then rinsing them thoroughly with water. But with the dishwasher, I've saved time, labor, and the mental stress associated with washing dishes. Stress is the root of all evil. Mental health is paramount, and this dishwasher makes me feel like I'm taking care of my mental health. I didn't research dishwashers well and bought them because of the brand and price, but foreign brands cost millions of won. This is the best domestic brand, and with this performance at this price, I think I made a good purchase! (Achievement of the Year) ] || ---------------- || (This is a review of installing a dishwasher and remodeling the sink.) When I moved into a new apartment, I did some interior design and bought appliances and furniture, and the first thing I considered was a dishwasher! I saw a commercial dishwasher while working part-time at a cafe and was blown away by its new design. However, I couldn't afford a commercial dishwasher at home, and due to budget constraints during the move, I looked for branded, reasonably priced products. Korea's leading home appliance brands are Samsung and L*ny, and Samsung products are more affordable, so I ended up choosing almost all Samsung products. There's a saying that "L*" is a household name for appliances, so when I moved to my parents' house, I had all the Samsung products, but this time, my budget didn't allow it. I had been very satisfied with the built-in Samsung appliances in my previous studio apartment, so I trusted them and bought a Samsung product. The installation process: I'd been eyeing the dishwasher on Coupang for a few days, and when the price improved, I bought it. I scheduled the installation for the day I moved in. The day before the installation, I got a call to schedule a visit. The dishwasher was unusual in that the sink remodeler came first, and then the dishwasher installer came separately. The remodeling felt like a bigger and more important task than the dishwasher installation, and it actually took longer. I wasn't very busy moving, but the installer came and went, and I think it took about an hour. They had to make room for the dishwasher, so in our case, we removed the oven under the induction range and installed the dishwasher there. However, the countertop didn't match, so we had to pay for the remodeling. ((It came out to be in the mid-100,000 won range, so I paid for it separately from the dishwasher.)) I didn't realize there was an additional remodeling fee, and it was even in the 100,000 won range. But I paid for the dishwasher anyway. The remodeling was incredibly thorough. They even applied film to the kitchen sink a week before the move, and they said it was a good idea to apply the film after the dishwasher was installed. Our house was installed in the following order: sink film removal, move-in cleaning, and dishwasher installation. The installer said it's better to install the dishwasher first because the film could peel off or cause problems during installation. 1. The best appliance in my life: a dishwasher. I used to get so angry when I came home that the sink was full of dishes to wash, and I'd get so angry when I had to wash them and cook. But now, even when the sink is full of dishes, I don't complain at all. It still feels like play. I don't feel the burden of washing dishes anymore. As I got older, my shoulders would hurt from washing dishes, and my back would get sore from standing for long periods. I'd often take breaks and then start again. But since the dishwasher arrived, dishwashing stress has disappeared. 2. A dishwasher with a maximum capacity of 14 people. People always say you should buy a 14-person dishwasher, but I think bigger is always better. I'm thinking about getting another 14-person dishwasher. It seats 14 people, but if you add a rice cooker inner pot, wok, or frying pan, the lower compartment is almost full. I think it was a good decision to get a large capacity. I'm still new to using it, so it was a bit difficult to stack dishes neatly. 3. Easy operation. I've never seen a home dishwasher before, and I saw it for the first time during installation. The technician showed me how to do it, but I forgot about it the next time I left, so I tried again and it was easy. 4. Cleanliness. I use Pro* dishwasher detergent, which is the most commonly used, and at first, there was some detergent residue, but with use, that residue disappeared and now it's clean. I used to use one bottle of Pro* dishwasher detergent, but I cut it in half. This half-bottle size is just the right amount, and the dishes feel cleaner. Sometimes, water collects where I place dishes upside down, and that water seems to contain detergent residue. Sometimes, I rinse the dishes with water to check if I washed them properly. I also pre-wash the dishes. There are still a few things to do with the dishwasher, rather than just throwing them in, but I'm so glad I bought it. Washing dishes takes a lot of effort and time, like scrubbing them with a sponge and then rinsing them thoroughly with water. But with the dishwasher, I've saved time, labor, and the mental stress associated with washing dishes. Stress is the root of all evil. Mental health is paramount, and this dishwasher makes me feel like I'm taking care of my mental health. I didn't research dishwashers well and bought them because of the brand and price, but foreign brands cost millions of won. This is the best domestic brand, and with this performance at this price, I think I made a good purchase! (Achievement of the Year) ] || ---------------- || (This is a review of installing a dishwasher and remodeling the sink.) When I moved into a new apartment, I did some interior design and bought appliances and furniture, and the first thing I considered was a dishwasher! I saw a commercial dishwasher while working part-time at a cafe and was blown away by its new design. However, I couldn't afford a commercial dishwasher at home, and due to budget constraints during the move, I looked for branded, reasonably priced products. Korea's leading home appliance brands are Samsung and L*ny, and Samsung products are more affordable, so I ended up choosing almost all Samsung products. There's a saying that "L*" is a household name for appliances, so when I moved to my parents' house, I had all the Samsung products, but this time, my budget didn't allow it. I had been very satisfied with the built-in Samsung appliances in my previous studio apartment, so I trusted them and bought a Samsung product. The installation process: I'd been eyeing the dishwasher on Coupang for a few days, and when the price improved, I bought it. I scheduled the installation for the day I moved in. The day before the installation, I got a call to schedule a visit. The dishwasher was unusual in that the sink remodeler came first, and then the dishwasher installer came separately. The remodeling felt like a bigger and more important task than the dishwasher installation, and it actually took longer. I wasn't very busy moving, but the installer came and went, and I think it took about an hour. They had to make room for the dishwasher, so in our case, we removed the oven under the induction range and installed the dishwasher there. However, the countertop didn't match, so we had to pay for the remodeling. ((It came out to be in the mid-100,000 won range, so I paid for it separately from the dishwasher.)) I didn't realize there was an additional remodeling fee, and it was even in the 100,000 won range. But I paid for the dishwasher anyway. The remodeling was incredibly thorough. They even applied film to the kitchen sink a week before the move, and they said it was a good idea to apply the film after the dishwasher was installed. Our house was installed in the following order: sink film removal, move-in cleaning, and dishwasher installation. The installer said it's better to install the dishwasher first because the film could peel off or cause problems during installation. 1. The best appliance in my life: a dishwasher. I used to get so angry when I came home that the sink was full of dishes to wash, and I'd get so angry when I had to wash them and cook. But now, even when the sink is full of dishes, I don't complain at all. It still feels like play. I don't feel the burden of washing dishes anymore. As I got older, my shoulders would hurt from washing dishes, and my back would get sore from standing for long periods. I'd often take breaks and then start again. But since the dishwasher arrived, dishwashing stress has disappeared. 2. A dishwasher with a maximum capacity of 14 people. People always say you should buy a 14-person dishwasher, but I think bigger is always better. I'm thinking about getting another 14-person dishwasher. It seats 14 people, but if you add a rice cooker inner pot, wok, or frying pan, the lower compartment is almost full. I think it was a good decision to get a large capacity. I'm still new to using it, so it was a bit difficult to stack dishes neatly. 3. Easy operation. I've never seen a home dishwasher before, and I saw it for the first time during installation. The technician showed me how to do it, but I forgot about it the next time I left, so I tried again and it was easy. 4. Cleanliness. I use Pro* dishwasher detergent, which is the most commonly used, and at first, there was some detergent residue, but with use, that residue disappeared and now it's clean. I used to use one bottle of Pro* dishwasher detergent, but I cut it in half. This half-bottle size is just the right amount, and the dishes feel cleaner. Sometimes, water collects where I place dishes upside down, and that water seems to contain detergent residue. Sometimes, I rinse the dishes with water to check if I washed them properly. I also pre-wash the dishes. There are still a few things to do with the dishwasher, rather than just throwing them in, but I'm so glad I bought it. Washing dishes takes a lot of effort and time, like scrubbing them with a sponge and then rinsing them thoroughly with water. But with the dishwasher, I've saved time, labor, and the mental stress associated with washing dishes. Stress is the root of all evil. Mental health is paramount, and this dishwasher makes me feel like I'm taking care of my mental health. I didn't research dishwashers well and bought them because of the brand and price, but foreign brands cost millions of won. This is the best domestic brand, and with this performance at this price, I think I made a good purchase! (Achievement of the Year) ] || ---------------- || (This is a review of installing a dishwasher and remodeling the sink.) When I moved into a new apartment, I did some interior design and bought appliances and furniture, and the first thing I considered was a dishwasher! I saw a commercial dishwasher while working part-time at a cafe and was blown away by its new design. However, I couldn't afford a commercial dishwasher at home, and due to budget constraints during the move, I looked for branded, reasonably priced products. Korea's leading home appliance brands are Samsung and L*ny, and Samsung products are more affordable, so I ended up choosing almost all Samsung products. There's a saying that "L*" is a household name for appliances, so when I moved to my parents' house, I had all the Samsung products, but this time, my budget didn't allow it. I had been very satisfied with the built-in Samsung appliances in my previous studio apartment, so I trusted them and bought a Samsung product. The installation process: I'd been eyeing the dishwasher on Coupang for a few days, and when the price improved, I bought it. I scheduled the installation for the day I moved in. The day before the installation, I got a call to schedule a visit. The dishwasher was unusual in that the sink remodeler came first, and then the dishwasher installer came separately. The remodeling felt like a bigger and more important task than the dishwasher installation, and it actually took longer. I wasn't very busy moving, but the installer came and went, and I think it took about an hour. They had to make room for the dishwasher, so in our case, we removed the oven under the induction range and installed the dishwasher there. However, the countertop didn't match, so we had to pay for the remodeling. ((It came out to be in the mid-100,000 won range, so I paid for it separately from the dishwasher.)) I didn't realize there was an additional remodeling fee, and it was even in the 100,000 won range. But I paid for the dishwasher anyway. The remodeling was incredibly thorough. They even applied film to the kitchen sink a week before the move, and they said it was a good idea to apply the film after the dishwasher was installed. Our house was installed in the following order: sink film removal, move-in cleaning, and dishwasher installation. The installer said it's better to install the dishwasher first because the film could peel off or cause problems during installation. 1. The best appliance in my life: a dishwasher. I used to get so angry when I came home that the sink was full of dishes to wash, and I'd get so angry when I had to wash them and cook. But now, even when the sink is full of dishes, I don't complain at all. It still feels like play. I don't feel the burden of washing dishes anymore. As I got older, my shoulders would hurt from washing dishes, and my back would get sore from standing for long periods. I'd often take breaks and then start again. But since the dishwasher arrived, dishwashing stress has disappeared. 2. A dishwasher with a maximum capacity of 14 people. People always say you should buy a 14-person dishwasher, but I think bigger is always better. I'm thinking about getting another 14-person dishwasher. It seats 14 people, but if you add a rice cooker inner pot, wok, or frying pan, the lower compartment is almost full. I think it was a good decision to get a large capacity. I'm still new to using it, so it was a bit difficult to stack dishes neatly. 3. Easy operation. I've never seen a home dishwasher before, and I saw it for the first time during installation. The technician showed me how to do it, but I forgot about it the next time I left, so I tried again and it was easy. 4. Cleanliness. I use Pro* dishwasher detergent, which is the most commonly used, and at first, there was some detergent residue, but with use, that residue disappeared and now it's clean. I used to use one bottle of Pro* dishwasher detergent, but I cut it in half. This half-bottle size is just the right amount, and the dishes feel cleaner. Sometimes, water collects where I place dishes upside down, and that water seems to contain detergent residue. Sometimes, I rinse the dishes with water to check if I washed them properly. I also pre-wash the dishes. There are still a few things to do with the dishwasher, rather than just throwing them in, but I'm so glad I bought it. Washing dishes takes a lot of effort and time, like scrubbing them with a sponge and then rinsing them thoroughly with water. But with the dishwasher, I've saved time, labor, and the mental stress associated with washing dishes. Stress is the root of all evil. Mental health is paramount, and this dishwasher makes me feel like I'm taking care of my mental health. I didn't research dishwashers well and bought them because of the brand and price, but foreign brands cost millions of won. This is the best domestic brand, and with this performance at this price, I think I made a good purchase! When I moved into a new apartment, I did some interior design and bought appliances and furniture, and the first thing I considered was a dishwasher! I saw a commercial dishwasher while working part-time at a cafe and was blown away by its new design. However, I couldn't afford a commercial dishwasher at home, and due to budget constraints during the move, I looked for branded, reasonably priced products. Korea's leading home appliance brands are Samsung and L*ny, and Samsung products are more affordable, so I ended up choosing almost all Samsung products. There's a saying that "L*" is a household name for appliances, so when I moved to my parents' house, I had all the Samsung products, but this time, my budget didn't allow it. I had been very satisfied with the built-in Samsung appliances in my previous studio apartment, so I trusted them and bought a Samsung product. The installation process: I'd been eyeing the dishwasher on Coupang for a few days, and when the price improved, I bought it. I scheduled the installation for the day I moved in. The day before the installation, I got a call to schedule a visit. The dishwasher was unusual in that the sink remodeler came first, and then the dishwasher installer came separately. The remodeling felt like a bigger and more important task than the dishwasher installation, and it actually took longer. I wasn't very busy moving, but the installer came and went, and I think it took about an hour. They had to make room for the dishwasher, so in our case, we removed the oven under the induction range and installed the dishwasher there. However, the countertop didn't match, so we had to pay for the remodeling. ((It came out to be in the mid-100,000 won range, so I paid for it separately from the dishwasher.)) I didn't realize there was an additional remodeling fee, and it was even in the 100,000 won range. But I paid for the dishwasher anyway. The remodeling was incredibly thorough. They even applied film to the kitchen sink a week before the move, and they said it was a good idea to apply the film after the dishwasher was installed. Our house was installed in the following order: sink film removal, move-in cleaning, and dishwasher installation. The installer said it's better to install the dishwasher first because the film could peel off or cause problems during installation. 1. The best appliance in my life: a dishwasher. I used to get so angry when I came home that the sink was full of dishes to wash, and I'd get so angry when I had to wash them and cook. But now, even when the sink is full of dishes, I don't complain at all. It still feels like play. I don't feel the burden of washing dishes anymore. As I got older, my shoulders would hurt from washing dishes, and my back would get sore from standing for long periods. I'd often take breaks and then start again. But since the dishwasher arrived, dishwashing stress has disappeared. 2. A dishwasher with a maximum capacity of 14 people. People always say you should buy a 14-person dishwasher, but I think bigger is always better. I'm thinking about getting another 14-person dishwasher. It seats 14 people, but if you add a rice cooker inner pot, wok, or frying pan, the lower compartment is almost full. I think it was a good decision to get a large capacity. I'm still new to using it, so it was a bit difficult to stack dishes neatly. 3. Easy operation. I've never seen a home dishwasher before, and I saw it for the first time during installation. The technician showed me how to do it, but I forgot about it the next time I left, so I tried again and it was easy. 4. Cleanliness. I use Pro* dishwasher detergent, which is the most commonly used, and at first, there was some detergent residue, but with use, that residue disappeared and now it's clean. I used to use one bottle of Pro* dishwasher detergent, but I cut it in half. This half-bottle size is just the right amount, and the dishes feel cleaner. Sometimes, water collects where I place dishes upside down, and that water seems to contain detergent residue. Sometimes, I rinse the dishes with water to check if I washed them properly. I also pre-wash the dishes. There are still a few things to do with the dishwasher, rather than just throwing them in, but I'm so glad I bought it. Washing dishes takes a lot of effort and time, like scrubbing them with a sponge and then rinsing them thoroughly with water. But with the dishwasher, I've saved time, labor, and the mental stress associated with washing dishes. Stress is the root of all evil. Mental health is paramount, and this dishwasher makes me feel like I'm taking care of my mental health. I didn't research dishwashers well and bought them because of the brand and price, but foreign brands cost millions of won. This is the best domestic brand, and with this performance at this price, I think I made a good purchase! (Achievement of the Year) ] || ---------------- || (This is a review of installing a dishwasher and remodeling the sink.) When I moved into a new apartment, I did some interior design and bought appliances and furniture, and the first thing I considered was a dishwasher! I saw a commercial dishwasher while working part-time at a cafe and was blown away by its new design. However, I couldn't afford a commercial dishwasher at home, and due to budget constraints during the move, I looked for branded, reasonably priced products. Korea's leading home appliance brands are Samsung and L*ny, and Samsung products are more affordable, so I ended up choosing almost all Samsung products. There's a saying that "L*" is a household name for appliances, so when I moved to my parents' house, I had all the Samsung products, but this time, my budget didn't allow it. I had been very satisfied with the built-in Samsung appliances in my previous studio apartment, so I trusted them and bought a Samsung product. The installation process: I'd been eyeing the dishwasher on Coupang for a few days, and when the price improved, I bought it. I scheduled the installation for the day I moved in. The day before the installation, I got a call to schedule a visit. The dishwasher was unusual in that the sink remodeler came first, and then the dishwasher installer came separately. The remodeling felt like a bigger and more important task than the dishwasher installation, and it actually took longer. I wasn't very busy moving, but the installer came and went, and I think it took about an hour. They had to make room for the dishwasher, so in our case, we removed the oven under the induction range and installed the dishwasher there. However, the countertop didn't match, so we had to pay for the remodeling. ((It came out to be in the mid-100,000 won range, so I paid for it separately from the dishwasher.)) I didn't realize there was an additional remodeling fee, and it was even in the 100,000 won range. But I paid for the dishwasher anyway. The remodeling was incredibly thorough. They even applied film to the kitchen sink a week before the move, and they said it was a good idea to apply the film after the dishwasher was installed. Our house was installed in the following order: sink film removal, move-in cleaning, and dishwasher installation. The installer said it's better to install the dishwasher first because the film could peel off or cause problems during installation. 1. The best appliance in my life: a dishwasher. I used to get so angry when I came home that the sink was full of dishes to wash, and I'd get so angry when I had to wash them and cook. But now, even when the sink is full of dishes, I don't complain at all. It still feels like play. I don't feel the burden of washing dishes anymore. As I got older, my shoulders would hurt from washing dishes, and my back would get sore from standing for long periods. I'd often take breaks and then start again. But since the dishwasher arrived, dishwashing stress has disappeared. 2. A dishwasher with a maximum capacity of 14 people. People always say you should buy a 14-person dishwasher, but I think bigger is always better. I'm thinking about getting another 14-person dishwasher. It seats 14 people, but if you add a rice cooker inner pot, wok, or frying pan, the lower compartment is almost full. I think it was a good decision to get a large capacity. I'm still new to using it, so it was a bit difficult to stack dishes neatly. 3. Easy operation. I've never seen a home dishwasher before, and I saw it for the first time during installation. The technician showed me how to do it, but I forgot about it the next time I left, so I tried again and it was easy. 4. Cleanliness. I use Pro* dishwasher detergent, which is the most commonly used, and at first, there was some detergent residue, but with use, that residue disappeared and now it's clean. I used to use one bottle of Pro* dishwasher detergent, but I cut it in half. This half-bottle size is just the right amount, and the dishes feel cleaner. Sometimes, water collects where I place dishes upside down, and that water seems to contain detergent residue. Sometimes, I rinse the dishes with water to check if I washed them properly. I also pre-wash the dishes. There are still a few things to do with the dishwasher, rather than just throwing them in, but I'm so glad I bought it. Washing dishes takes a lot of effort and time, like scrubbing them with a sponge and then rinsing them thoroughly with water. But with the dishwasher, I've saved time, labor, and the mental stress associated with washing dishes. Stress is the root of all evil. Mental health is paramount, and this dishwasher makes me feel like I'm taking care of my mental health. I didn't research dishwashers well and bought them because of the brand and price, but foreign brands cost millions of won. This is the best domestic brand, and with this performance at this price, I think I made a good purchase! (Achievement of the Year) ] || ---------------- || (This is a review of installing a dishwasher and remodeling the sink.) When I moved into a new apartment, I did some interior design and bought appliances and furniture, and the first thing I considered was a dishwasher! I saw a commercial dishwasher while working part-time at a cafe and was blown away by its new design. However, I couldn't afford a commercial dishwasher at home, and due to budget constraints during the move, I looked for branded, reasonably priced products. Korea's leading home appliance brands are Samsung and L*ny, and Samsung products are more affordable, so I ended up choosing almost all Samsung products. There's a saying that "L*" is a household name for appliances, so when I moved to my parents' house, I had all the Samsung products, but this time, my budget didn't allow it. I had been very satisfied with the built-in Samsung appliances in my previous studio apartment, so I trusted them and bought a Samsung product. The installation process: I'd been eyeing the dishwasher on Coupang for a few days, and when the price improved, I bought it. I scheduled the installation for the day I moved in. The day before the installation, I got a call to schedule a visit. The dishwasher was unusual in that the sink remodeler came first, and then the dishwasher installer came separately. The remodeling felt like a bigger and more important task than the dishwasher installation, and it actually took longer. I wasn't very busy moving, but the installer came and went, and I think it took about an hour. They had to make room for the dishwasher, so in our case, we removed the oven under the induction range and installed the dishwasher there. However, the countertop didn't match, so we had to pay for the remodeling. ((It came out to be in the mid-100,000 won range, so I paid for it separately from the dishwasher.)) I didn't realize there was an additional remodeling fee, and it was even in the 100,000 won range. But I paid for the dishwasher anyway. The remodeling was incredibly thorough. They even applied film to the kitchen sink a week before the move, and they said it was a good idea to apply the film after the dishwasher was installed. Our house was installed in the following order: sink film removal, move-in cleaning, and dishwasher installation. The installer said it's better to install the dishwasher first because the film could peel off or cause problems during installation. 1. The best appliance in my life: a dishwasher. I used to get so angry when I came home that the sink was full of dishes to wash, and I'd get so angry when I had to wash them and cook. But now, even when the sink is full of dishes, I don't complain at all. It still feels like play. I don't feel the burden of washing dishes anymore. As I got older, my shoulders would hurt from washing dishes, and my back would get sore from standing for long periods. I'd often take breaks and then start again. But since the dishwasher arrived, dishwashing stress has disappeared. 2. A dishwasher with a maximum capacity of 14 people. People always say you should buy a 14-person dishwasher, but I think bigger is always better. I'm thinking about getting another 14-person dishwasher. It seats 14 people, but if you add a rice cooker inner pot, wok, or frying pan, the lower compartment is almost full. I think it was a good decision to get a large capacity. I'm still new to using it, so it was a bit difficult to stack dishes neatly. 3. Easy operation. I've never seen a home dishwasher before, and I saw it for the first time during installation. The technician showed me how to do it, but I forgot about it the next time I left, so I tried again and it was easy. 4. Cleanliness. I use Pro* dishwasher detergent, which is the most commonly used, and at first, there was some detergent residue, but with use, that residue disappeared and now it's clean. I used to use one bottle of Pro* dishwasher detergent, but I cut it in half. This half-bottle size is just the right amount, and the dishes feel cleaner. Sometimes, water collects where I place dishes upside down, and that water seems to contain detergent residue. Sometimes, I rinse the dishes with water to check if I washed them properly. I also pre-wash the dishes. There are still a few things to do with the dishwasher, rather than just throwing them in, but I'm so glad I bought it. Washing dishes takes a lot of effort and time, like scrubbing them with a sponge and then rinsing them thoroughly with water. But with the dishwasher, I've saved time, labor, and the mental stress associated with washing dishes. Stress is the root of all evil. Mental health is paramount, and this dishwasher makes me feel like I'm taking care of my mental health. I didn't research dishwashers well and bought them because of the brand and price, but foreign brands cost millions of won. This is the best domestic brand, and with this performance at this price, I think I made a good purchase! (Achievement of the Year) ] || ---------------- || (This is a review of installing a dishwasher and remodeling the sink.) When I moved into a new apartment, I did some interior design and bought appliances and furniture, and the first thing I considered was a dishwasher! I saw a commercial dishwasher while working part-time at a cafe and was blown away by its new design. However, I couldn't afford a commercial dishwasher at home, and due to budget constraints during the move, I looked for branded, reasonably priced products. Korea's leading home appliance brands are Samsung and L*ny, and Samsung products are more affordable, so I ended up choosing almost all Samsung products. There's a saying that "L*" is a household name for appliances, so when I moved to my parents' house, I had all the Samsung products, but this time, my budget didn't allow it. I had been very satisfied with the built-in Samsung appliances in my previous studio apartment, so I trusted them and bought a Samsung product. The installation process: I'd been eyeing the dishwasher on Coupang for a few days, and when the price improved, I bought it. I scheduled the installation for the day I moved in. The day before the installation, I got a call to schedule a visit. The dishwasher was unusual in that the sink remodeler came first, and then the dishwasher installer came separately. The remodeling felt like a bigger and more important task than the dishwasher installation, and it actually took longer. I wasn't very busy moving, but the installer came and went, and I think it took about an hour. They had to make room for the dishwasher, so in our case, we removed the oven under the induction range and installed the dishwasher there. However, the countertop didn't match, so we had to pay for the remodeling. ((It came out to be in the mid-100,000 won range, so I paid for it separately from the dishwasher.)) I didn't realize there was an additional remodeling fee, and it was even in the 100,000 won range. But I paid for the dishwasher anyway. The remodeling was incredibly thorough. They even applied film to the kitchen sink a week before the move, and they said it was a good idea to apply the film after the dishwasher was installed. Our house was installed in the following order: sink film removal, move-in cleaning, and dishwasher installation. The installer said it's better to install the dishwasher first because the film could peel off or cause problems during installation. 1. The best appliance in my life: a dishwasher. I used to get so angry when I came home that the sink was full of dishes to wash, and I'd get so angry when I had to wash them and cook. But now, even when the sink is full of dishes, I don't complain at all. It still feels like play. I don't feel the burden of washing dishes anymore. As I got older, my shoulders would hurt from washing dishes, and my back would get sore from standing for long periods. I'd often take breaks and then start again. But since the dishwasher arrived, dishwashing stress has disappeared. 2. A dishwasher with a maximum capacity of 14 people. People always say you should buy a 14-person dishwasher, but I think bigger is always better. I'm thinking about getting another 14-person dishwasher. It seats 14 people, but if you add a rice cooker inner pot, wok, or frying pan, the lower compartment is almost full. I think it was a good decision to get a large capacity. I'm still new to using it, so it was a bit difficult to stack dishes neatly. 3. Easy operation. I've never seen a home dishwasher before, and I saw it for the first time during installation. The technician showed me how to do it, but I forgot about it the next time I left, so I tried again and it was easy. 4. Cleanliness. I use Pro* dishwasher detergent, which is the most commonly used, and at first, there was some detergent residue, but with use, that residue disappeared and now it's clean. I used to use one bottle of Pro* dishwasher detergent, but I cut it in half. This half-bottle size is just the right amount, and the dishes feel cleaner. Sometimes, water collects where I place dishes upside down, and that water seems to contain detergent residue. Sometimes, I rinse the dishes with water to check if I washed them properly. I also pre-wash the dishes. There are still a few things to do with the dishwasher, rather than just throwing them in, but I'm so glad I bought it. Washing dishes takes a lot of effort and time, like scrubbing them with a sponge and then rinsing them thoroughly with water. But with the dishwasher, I've saved time, labor, and the mental stress associated with washing dishes. Stress is the root of all evil. Mental health is paramount, and this dishwasher makes me feel like I'm taking care of my mental health. I didn't research dishwashers well and bought them because of the brand and price, but foreign brands cost millions of won. This is the best domestic brand, and with this performance at this price, I think I made a good purchase! (Achievement of the Year) ] || ---------------- || (This is a review of installing a dishwasher and remodeling the sink.) When I moved into a new apartment, I did some interior design and bought appliances and furniture, and the first thing I considered was a dishwasher! I saw a commercial dishwasher while working part-time at a cafe and was blown away by its new design. However, I couldn't afford a commercial dishwasher at home, and due to budget constraints during the move, I looked for branded, reasonably priced products. Korea's leading home appliance brands are Samsung and L*ny, and Samsung products are more affordable, so I ended up choosing almost all Samsung products. There's a saying that "L*" is a household name for appliances, so when I moved to my parents' house, I had all the Samsung products, but this time, my budget didn't allow it. I had been very satisfied with the built-in Samsung appliances in my previous studio apartment, so I trusted them and bought a Samsung product. The installation process: I'd been eyeing the dishwasher on Coupang for a few days, and when the price improved, I bought it. I scheduled the installation for the day I moved in. The day before the installation, I got a call to schedule a visit. The dishwasher was unusual in that the sink remodeler came first, and then the dishwasher installer came separately. The remodeling felt like a bigger and more important task than the dishwasher installation, and it actually took longer. I wasn't very busy moving, but the installer came and went, and I think it took about an hour. They had to make room for the dishwasher, so in our case, we removed the oven under the induction range and installed the dishwasher there. However, the countertop didn't match, so we had to pay for the remodeling. ((It came out to be in the mid-100,000 won range, so I paid for it separately from the dishwasher.)) I didn't realize there was an additional remodeling fee, and it was even in the 100,000 won range. But I paid for the dishwasher anyway. The remodeling was incredibly thorough. They even applied film to the kitchen sink a week before the move, and they said it was a good idea to apply the film after the dishwasher was installed. Our house was installed in the following order: sink film removal, move-in cleaning, and dishwasher installation. The installer said it's better to install the dishwasher first because the film could peel off or cause problems during installation. 1. The best appliance in my life: a dishwasher. I used to get so angry when I came home that the sink was full of dishes to wash, and I'd get so angry when I had to wash them and cook. But now, even when the sink is full of dishes, I don't complain at all. It still feels like play. I don't feel the burden of washing dishes anymore. As I got older, my shoulders would hurt from washing dishes, and my back would get sore from standing for long periods. I'd often take breaks and then start again. But since the dishwasher arrived, dishwashing stress has disappeared. 2. A dishwasher with a maximum capacity of 14 people. People always say you should buy a 14-person dishwasher, but I think bigger is always better. I'm thinking about getting another 14-person dishwasher. It seats 14 people, but if you add a rice cooker inner pot, wok, or frying pan, the lower compartment is almost full. I think it was a good decision to get a large capacity. I'm still new to using it, so it was a bit difficult to stack dishes neatly. 3. Easy operation. I've never seen a home dishwasher before, and I saw it for the first time during installation. The technician showed me how to do it, but I forgot about it the next time I left, so I tried again and it was easy. 4. Cleanliness. I use Pro* dishwasher detergent, which is the most commonly used, and at first, there was some detergent residue, but with use, that residue disappeared and now it's clean. I used to use one bottle of Pro* dishwasher detergent, but I cut it in half. This half-bottle size is just the right amount, and the dishes feel cleaner. Sometimes, water collects where I place dishes upside down, and that water seems to contain detergent residue. Sometimes, I rinse the dishes with water to check if I washed them properly. I also pre-wash the dishes. There are still a few things to do with the dishwasher, rather than just throwing them in, but I'm so glad I bought it. Washing dishes takes a lot of effort and time, like scrubbing them with a sponge and then rinsing them thoroughly with water. But with the dishwasher, I've saved time, labor, and the mental stress associated with washing dishes. Stress is the root of all evil. Mental health is paramount, and this dishwasher makes me feel like I'm taking care of my mental health. I didn't research dishwashers well and bought them because of the brand and price, but foreign brands cost millions of won. This is the best domestic brand, and with this performance at this price, I think I made a good purchase! (Achievement of the Year) ] || ---------------- || (This is a review of installing a dishwasher and remodeling the sink.) When I moved into a new apartment, I did some interior design and bought appliances and furniture, and the first thing I considered was a dishwasher! I saw a commercial dishwasher while working part-time at a cafe and was blown away by its new design. However, I couldn't afford a commercial dishwasher at home, and due to budget constraints during the move, I looked for branded, reasonably priced products. Korea's leading home appliance brands are Samsung and L*ny, and Samsung products are more affordable, so I ended up choosing almost all Samsung products. There's a saying that "L*" is a household name for appliances, so when I moved to my parents' house, I had all the Samsung products, but this time, my budget didn't allow it. I had been very satisfied with the built-in Samsung appliances in my previous studio apartment, so I trusted them and bought a Samsung product. The installation process: I'd been eyeing the dishwasher on Coupang for a few days, and when the price improved, I bought it. I scheduled the installation for the day I moved in. The day before the installation, I got a call to schedule a visit. The dishwasher was unusual in that the sink remodeler came first, and then the dishwasher installer came separately. The remodeling felt like a bigger and more important task than the dishwasher installation, and it actually took longer. I wasn't very busy moving, but the installer came and went, and I think it took about an hour. They had to make room for the dishwasher, so in our case, we removed the oven under the induction range and installed the dishwasher there. However, the countertop didn't match, so we had to pay for the remodeling. ((It came out to be in the mid-100,000 won range, so I paid for it separately from the dishwasher.)) I didn't realize there was an additional remodeling fee, and it was even in the 100,000 won range. But I paid for the dishwasher anyway. The remodeling was incredibly thorough. They even applied film to the kitchen sink a week before the move, and they said it was a good idea to apply the film after the dishwasher was installed. Our house was installed in the following order: sink film removal, move-in cleaning, and dishwasher installation. The installer said it's better to install the dishwasher first because the film could peel off or cause problems during installation. 1. The best appliance in my life: a dishwasher. I used to get so angry when I came home that the sink was full of dishes to wash, and I'd get so angry when I had to wash them and cook. But now, even when the sink is full of dishes, I don't complain at all. It still feels like play. I don't feel the burden of washing dishes anymore. As I got older, my shoulders would hurt from washing dishes, and my back would get sore from standing for long periods. I'd often take breaks and then start again. But since the dishwasher arrived, dishwashing stress has disappeared. 2. A dishwasher with a maximum capacity of 14 people. People always say you should buy a 14-person dishwasher, but I think bigger is always better. I'm thinking about getting another 14-person dishwasher. It seats 14 people, but if you add a rice cooker inner pot, wok, or frying pan, the lower compartment is almost full. I think it was a good decision to get a large capacity. I'm still new to using it, so it was a bit difficult to stack dishes neatly. 3. Easy operation. I've never seen a home dishwasher before, and I saw it for the first time during installation. The technician showed me how to do it, but I forgot about it the next time I left, so I tried again and it was easy. 4. Cleanliness. I use Pro* dishwasher detergent, which is the most commonly used, and at first, there was some detergent residue, but with use, that residue disappeared and now it's clean. I used to use one bottle of Pro* dishwasher detergent, but I cut it in half. This half-bottle size is just the right amount, and the dishes feel cleaner. Sometimes, water collects where I place dishes upside down, and that water seems to contain detergent residue. Sometimes, I rinse the dishes with water to check if I washed them properly. I also pre-wash the dishes. There are still a few things to do with the dishwasher, rather than just throwing them in, but I'm so glad I bought it. Washing dishes takes a lot of effort and time, like scrubbing them with a sponge and then rinsing them thoroughly with water. But with the dishwasher, I've saved time, labor, and the mental stress associated with washing dishes. Stress is the root of all evil. Mental health is paramount, and this dishwasher makes me feel like I'm taking care of my mental health. I didn't research dishwashers well and bought them because of the brand and price, but foreign brands cost millions of won. This is the best domestic brand, and with this performance at this price, I think I made a good purchase! (Achievement of the Year) ] || ---------------- || (This is a review of installing a dishwasher and remodeling the sink.) When I moved into a new apartment, I did some interior design and bought appliances and furniture, and the first thing I considered was a dishwasher! I saw a commercial dishwasher while working part-time at a cafe and was blown away by its new design. However, I couldn't afford a commercial dishwasher at home, and due to budget constraints during the move, I looked for branded, reasonably priced products. Korea's leading home appliance brands are Samsung and L*ny, and Samsung products are more affordable, so I ended up choosing almost all Samsung products. There's a saying that "L*" is a household name for appliances, so when I moved to my parents' house, I had all the Samsung products, but this time, my budget didn't allow it. I had been very satisfied with the built-in Samsung appliances in my previous studio apartment, so I trusted them and bought a Samsung product. The installation process: I'd been eyeing the dishwasher on Coupang for a few days, and when the price improved, I bought it. I scheduled the installation for the day I moved in. The day before the installation, I got a call to schedule a visit. The dishwasher was unusual in that the sink remodeler came first, and then the dishwasher installer came separately. The remodeling felt like a bigger and more important task than the dishwasher installation, and it actually took longer. I wasn't very busy moving, but the installer came and went, and I think it took about an hour. They had to make room for the dishwasher, so in our case, we removed the oven under the induction range and installed the dishwasher there. However, the countertop didn't match, so we had to pay for the remodeling. ((It came out to be in the mid-100,000 won range, so I paid for it separately from the dishwasher.)) I didn't realize there was an additional remodeling fee, and it was even in the 100,000 won range. But I paid for the dishwasher anyway. The remodeling was incredibly thorough. They even applied film to the kitchen sink a week before the move, and they said it was a good idea to apply the film after the dishwasher was installed. Our house was installed in the following order: sink film removal, move-in cleaning, and dishwasher installation. The installer said it's better to install the dishwasher first because the film could peel off or cause problems during installation. 1. The best appliance in my life: a dishwasher. I used to get so angry when I came home that the sink was full of dishes to wash, and I'd get so angry when I had to wash them and cook. But now, even when the sink is full of dishes, I don't complain at all. It still feels like play. I don't feel the burden of washing dishes anymore. As I got older, my shoulders would hurt from washing dishes, and my back would get sore from standing for long periods. I'd often take breaks and then start again. But since the dishwasher arrived, dishwashing stress has disappeared. 2. A dishwasher with a maximum capacity of 14 people. People always say you should buy a 14-person dishwasher, but I think bigger is always better. I'm thinking about getting another 14-person dishwasher. It seats 14 people, but if you add a rice cooker inner pot, wok, or frying pan, the lower compartment is almost full. I think it was a good decision to get a large capacity. I'm still new to using it, so it was a bit difficult to stack dishes neatly. 3. Easy operation. I've never seen a home dishwasher before, and I saw it for the first time during installation. The technician showed me how to do it, but I forgot about it the next time I left, so I tried again and it was easy. 4. Cleanliness. I use Pro* dishwasher detergent, which is the most commonly used, and at first, there was some detergent residue, but with use, that residue disappeared and now it's clean. I used to use one bottle of Pro* dishwasher detergent, but I cut it in half. This half-bottle size is just the right amount, and the dishes feel cleaner. Sometimes, water collects where I place dishes upside down, and that water seems to contain detergent residue. Sometimes, I rinse the dishes with water to check if I washed them properly. I also pre-wash the dishes. There are still a few things to do with the dishwasher, rather than just throwing them in, but I'm so glad I bought it. Washing dishes takes a lot of effort and time, like scrubbing them with a sponge and then rinsing them thoroughly with water. But with the dishwasher, I've saved time, labor, and the mental stress associated with washing dishes. Stress is the root of all evil. Mental health is paramount, and this dishwasher makes me feel like I'm taking care of my mental health. I didn't research dishwashers well and bought them because of the brand and price, but foreign brands cost millions of won. This is the best domestic brand, and with this performance at this price, I think I made a good purchase! (Achievement of the Year) ] || ---------------- || (This is a review of installing a dishwasher and remodeling the sink.) When I moved into a new apartment, I did some interior design and bought appliances and furniture, and the first thing I considered was a dishwasher! I saw a commercial dishwasher while working part-time at a cafe and was blown away by its new design. However, I couldn't afford a commercial dishwasher at home, and due to budget constraints during the move, I looked for branded, reasonably priced products. Korea's leading home appliance brands are Samsung and L*ny, and Samsung products are more affordable, so I ended up choosing almost all Samsung products. There's a saying that "L*" is a household name for appliances, so when I moved to my parents' house, I had all the Samsung products, but this time, my budget didn't allow it. I had been very satisfied with the built-in Samsung appliances in my previous studio apartment, so I trusted them and bought a Samsung product. The installation process: I'd been eyeing the dishwasher on Coupang for a few days, and when the price improved, I bought it. I scheduled the installation for the day I moved in. The day before the installation, I got a call to schedule a visit. The dishwasher was unusual in that the sink remodeler came first, and then the dishwasher installer came separately. The remodeling felt like a bigger and more important task than the dishwasher installation, and it actually took longer. I wasn't very busy moving, but the installer came and went, and I think it took about an hour. They had to make room for the dishwasher, so in our case, we removed the oven under the induction range and installed the dishwasher there. However, the countertop didn't match, so we had to pay for the remodeling. ((It came out to be in the mid-100,000 won range, so I paid for it separately from the dishwasher.)) I didn't realize there was an additional remodeling fee, and it was even in the 100,000 won range. But I paid for the dishwasher anyway. The remodeling was incredibly thorough. They even applied film to the kitchen sink a week before the move, and they said it was a good idea to apply the film after the dishwasher was installed. Our house was installed in the following order: sink film removal, move-in cleaning, and dishwasher installation. The installer said it's better to install the dishwasher first because the film could peel off or cause problems during installation. 1. The best appliance in my life: a dishwasher. I used to get so angry when I came home that the sink was full of dishes to wash, and I'd get so angry when I had to wash them and cook. But now, even when the sink is full of dishes, I don't complain at all. It still feels like play. I don't feel the burden of washing dishes anymore. As I got older, my shoulders would hurt from washing dishes, and my back would get sore from standing for long periods. I'd often take breaks and then start again. But since the dishwasher arrived, dishwashing stress has disappeared. 2. A dishwasher with a maximum capacity of 14 people. People always say you should buy a 14-person dishwasher, but I think bigger is always better. I'm thinking about getting another 14-person dishwasher. It seats 14 people, but if you add a rice cooker inner pot, wok, or frying pan, the lower compartment is almost full. I think it was a good decision to get a large capacity. I'm still new to using it, so it was a bit difficult to stack dishes neatly. 3. Easy operation. I've never seen a home dishwasher before, and I saw it for the first time during installation. The technician showed me how to do it, but I forgot about it the next time I left, so I tried again and it was easy. 4. Cleanliness. I use Pro* dishwasher detergent, which is the most commonly used, and at first, there was some detergent residue, but with use, that residue disappeared and now it's clean. I used to use one bottle of Pro* dishwasher detergent, but I cut it in half. This half-bottle size is just the right amount, and the dishes feel cleaner. Sometimes, water collects where I place dishes upside down, and that water seems to contain detergent residue. Sometimes, I rinse the dishes with water to check if I washed them properly. I also pre-wash the dishes. There are still a few things to do with the dishwasher, rather than just throwing them in, but I'm so glad I bought it. Washing dishes takes a lot of effort and time, like scrubbing them with a sponge and then rinsing them thoroughly with water. But with the dishwasher, I've saved time, labor, and the mental stress associated with washing dishes. Stress is the root of all evil. Mental health is paramount, and this dishwasher makes me feel like I'm taking care of my mental health. I didn't research dishwashers well and bought them because of the brand and price, but foreign brands cost millions of won. This is the best domestic brand, and with this performance at this price, I think I made a good purchase!
